chapter: Chapter I: Basic Concepts of Complex Geometry

examples.title: Holomorphic Functions
examples.content: A function f: M → ℂ on a complex manifold is holomorphic if it is complex-differentiable in every coordinate chart. This is equivalent to satisfying the Cauchy-Riemann equations.

examples.title: Complex Manifolds
examples.content: A complex manifold of dimension n is a real 2n-dimensional manifold with an atlas to ℂⁿ where all transition maps are biholomorphic (holomorphic with holomorphic inverse).

simulator.title: Holomorphic Function Visualization
simulator.description: Visualizing |f(z)|² for a complex function. The height represents the modulus of the function value.

applications.title: Quantum Mechanics
applications.description: Wave functions are complex-valued, and their modulus squared gives probability density.

applications.title: Signal Processing
applications.description: Analytic signals and the Hilbert transform rely on complex analysis.

concepts.name: Biholomorphism
concepts.definition: A bijective holomorphic map whose inverse is also holomorphic.

concepts.name: Complex Structure
concepts.definition: An almost complex structure J satisfying the integrability condition [J,J] = 0.

exercises.question: Show that ℂⁿ is a complex manifold with a single chart.
exercises.hint: The identity map is trivially biholomorphic.

exercises.question: Prove that a holomorphic function on a compact connected complex manifold is constant.

diagrams.title: Gradient of |f(z)|²
diagrams.description: The gradient flow of the squared modulus for f(z) = z².
diagrams.instructions: Observe how the flow points toward minima.
